newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel Eddie Bauer June same-store sales.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel Eddie Bauer June same-store sales.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said June same-store sales at its Eddie Bauer unit were up three percent for the five-weeks ended June 28.
The retailer said its total sales for the period were $258.7 million, a nine percent increase from sales of $237.3 million in the same period last year.
For the 26 weeks ended June 28, 1997, total sales of $1.22 billion were slightly above sales of $1.21 billion for the year-ago period.
For the 26 weeks ended June 28, 1997, comparable store sales increased three percent on top of a three percent increase in the comparable period last year.
Spiegel sells apparel and home furnishings through catalogs and more than 450 stores.
